prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: an attorney managing a parent's account. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"Where an account is being managed by an attorney acting under a valid power of attorney, we will need to see the original document or a certified copy before we can make any changes to the account.
